name: D2 re-observation interface analysis
purpose: separate accumulated open-loop rollout error from local transition/response error before any new model training

data.neighborhood_validation_rule: first ceil(12%) of numerically sorted episode ids, identical to D4
data.nested_validation_rule: groups from the same held-out episode ids

conditions.construction: each forecast segment starts from the recorded physical state at the preceding segment boundary; reported states remain model predictions, so interval 1 is one-step teacher forcing rather than copied physics
conditions.interpretation: oracle interface diagnostic, not a deployable counterfactual rollout

neighborhood: smooth-versus-branch candidate decision agreement, recall, and added-positive rate against physical trajectories
response, topology, and local commitment errors
measurements.aggregation: all ten seeds; medians and ranges; no best-seed selection

decision_rule.short_horizon_pass: an interval in 1/2/4 improves median physical-candidate recall and median final-consequence recall by at least 0.10 each versus interval 38, while candidate and final added-positive rates are no more than 0.05 above interval 38
decision_rule.if_pass: prefer repeated short-horizon monitoring/re-observation and design its causal runtime version
decision_rule.if_fail: prefer a direct local action-response/boundary model; do not train another long open-loop Jenga dynamics model
